mechanics.claim: The shield is granted instantly on cast for both K'Sante and the potential allied champion, not on arrival.
mechanics.quote: The shield is granted instantly on cast for both '''K'Sante''' and the potential allied champion.

mechanics.claim: K'Sante can cast any of his abilities during the Footwork dash.
mechanics.quote: '''''K'Sante''' can cast any of his {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''

mechanics.claim: The shield does not refresh if cast while the shield is already active, and there is a short window after expiry where it also fails to refresh.
mechanics.quote: The shield will not refresh if K'sante casts ''Footwork'' while the shield is already active, nor will it always refresh for a short duration after the shield expires.

mechanics.claim: If the target ally is a champion, they also receive the shield.
mechanics.quote: If the target ally is a {{tip|champion}}, they receive the {{tip|shield}} as well.
